summary: Filing is an 8-K reporting a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of common stock. AXT sold 8,560,311 shares at $64.25 per share for ~$550M gross; underwriters have a 30-day option for 1,284,046 additional shares. The offering closed April 22, 2026 proceeds will fund subsidiary expansion and R&D. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
